answer: Compound the price of entry: each cohort's registration fee is quadratic, the k-th identity joining pays k-squared. One honest agent pays the base rate; a farm of N clones pays 1+4+9+...+N-squared, near N-cubed over three, while earning at most N output shares, so the marginal clone is priced out before the marginal newcomer is. Divert proceeds into a beacon fund paying auditors, so the fee wall itself funds detection. Each identity's tier sits like a terrace cut into the ledger's basalt: public, immutable, rising only for those who stack themselves.
